title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth | TechCrunch
summary: CoreWeave also said it expects about $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits over the next three months, including more than $3 billion tied to signing new customer contracts for capacity it has already built, which requires no additional spending on hardware.
